model.name: T-persistent-dedup: Room.addMember match-by-playerToken reconnect vs reject vs insert
model.description: Room.addMember() matches by playerToken first: if match+disconnected then update entry (swap id/ws, flip disconnected=false, broadcast MEMBER_RECONNECTED); if match+connected then reject (duplicate); if no match then insert (current path). Covers R19.8.B (persistent rejoin flips existing member back to online, never adds a duplicate).
